bahuvrīhi compound jita-akṣaḥ with enclitic ca; nominative singular masculine
ordinal adjective qualifying an implied feminine object such as vidyā
optative expressing injunction or prescribed practice

items.question: What qualifications entitle a practitioner to worship the fifth and most secret knowledge?
premises: Devotion to the teacher is a required qualification.
Mastery over the senses is a required qualification.
The fifth knowledge is to be worshipped through prescribed practice.
items.inference: Only a practitioner devoted to the teacher and master of the senses is fit to worship the fifth knowledge.
uncertainties: The specific referent of pañcamīṃ is implied by context rather than explicitly named in this verse.
items.plain_english: One who is devoted to the guru and has conquered the senses should worship the fifth.
